parameterGroups.system: Managed by the application and unavailable settings

epochs.label: Epochs
epochs.hint: How many times the model goes through the training part of the dataset.

batch.label: Batch size
batch.hint: Whole frames per step; −1 — AutoBatch; a fraction from 0 to 1 — a share of video memory.

device.label: Device
device.hint: The processor, a GPU number or any free GPU (−1).

amp.label: Mixed precision (AMP)
amp.hint: On the processor and on GPUs where mixed precision fails, the worker turns it off itself; the passport shows the actual value.

time.label: Time limit, hours
time.hint: Empty — no time limit. The limit can end training before the number of epochs.

patience.label: Patience, epochs
patience.hint: Empty — max(10, min(40, epochs)). 0 turns early stopping off.

pretrained.label: Start from pretrained weights
pretrained.hint: Off — random initialization of the model.

clsRemap.label: Carry over weights of known classes

freeze.label: Freeze layers
freeze.hint: Empty — no freezing; a number of first layers or a list of indices/names separated by commas.

channelsLast.label: Channels-last memory format
channelsLast.hint: Auto — the choice of the installed runtime.

optimizer.label: Optimizer
optimizer.hint: auto can choose the actual learning rate and momentum; the passport shows the result.

lr0.label: Initial learning rate (lr0)
lr0.hint: Empty — 0.001 · batch / 32. With the auto optimizer the optimizer chooses the rate.

warmupEpochs.label: Warmup, epochs
warmupEpochs.hint: Empty — by epochs and batch: at least one epoch and at most a quarter of training.

workers.label: Loader workers
workers.hint: Empty — 0 on Windows: loading in the main process is more reliable.

singleCls.label: Merge all classes into one
singleCls.hint: All chosen classes become one output of the model.

fraction.label: Fraction of training data
fraction.hint: A number from 0 to 1 or a list of fractions by split separated by commas.

classes.label: Class indices to train
classes.hint: Empty — all classes; indices from the dataset map separated by commas.

degrees.label: Rotation, degrees
degrees.hint: A positive value sets a random angle from −value to +value.

translate.label: Image translation
translate.hint: A share of width and height; 0 turns translation off.

scale.label: Image scale
scale.hint: A number for a symmetric range or two factors min, max separated by a comma.

closeMosaic.label: Turn mosaic off, epochs before the end

multiScale.label: Input size variation range
multiScale.hint: 0 turns random input size changes off.

val.label: Check quality after epochs
val.hint: Off — no check after each epoch. The installed runtime runs the final check.

split.label: Validation split
split.hint: Used to check quality; train gives no independent estimate.

conf.label: Validation confidence threshold
conf.hint: Empty — the runtime chooses the threshold.

save.label: Save weights during training
save.hint: Off — no intermediate weights; the final model is always saved.

unavailableReasons.system: Managed by the application: the chosen model, the immutable dataset and the working folder of the run.
unavailableReasons.otherMode: A parameter of another mode: predict, val, export or track; it does not change detect train.
unavailableReasons.notDetect: Does not apply to the detect task.
unavailableReasons.profile: Profiling needs TensorRT, ONNXRuntime and external integrations missing from the current build.
unavailableReasons.compile: Compilation needs Triton, missing from the pinned Windows build.
unavailableReasons.resume: Resuming needs a saved checkpoint with optimizer state; finished versions hold weights for inference.
unavailableReasons.quantize: QAT needs a separate compatible export path and artifact checks; the current passport supports regular weights.
unavailableReasons.distill_model: The teacher must be a local verified model with a compatible architecture; choosing a teacher model is not implemented yet.
unavailableReasons.dis: The distillation weight is available only together with a verified teacher model.

formWarnings.dataset_corrupt: The dataset files failed the check. Build a new version from the sources.
formWarnings.input_size_mismatch: The dataset input size does not match the project settings. Build the dataset again.
formWarnings.batch_exceeds_frames: The batch size ({{batch}}) is larger than the number of training frames ({{frames}}): reduce batch.
formWarnings.no_validation: The dataset has no Validation frames: the model quality will not be checked.

runErrors.interrupted: The run was interrupted. Start training again.
runErrors.failed: Training ended with an error. Check the log, the dataset and the parameters before running again.

passport.noActual: Actual parameters were not saved for this version.

passport.noImages: No images: the worker did not send any.

runPassport.logHistoryCaption: Messages saved in total: {{total}}. A page holds up to {{window}} messages.

settings.emptyText: Training runs on an immutable dataset version of the project. There are no datasets yet: annotate images and build a dataset.
settings.runtimeNotConfigured: The Python worker is not configured.
settings.autoNote: Empty “Auto” fields show the value training will choose. The actual precision and batch size go to the passport.
settings.advancedNote: An empty warmup is chosen by batch and number of epochs (at most a quarter of the run). Seed makes the run reproducible.
settings.validHint: The actual training parameters go to the version passport.
settings.architectureNote: Architecture {{architecture}}, input {{width}} × {{height}}. One run trains at a time; the next ones wait in the queue for the GPU. A successful run creates a new model version; earlier versions do not change.

presets.label: Parameter preset
presets.name: Preset name
presets.overwriteHint: The preset “{{name}}” will be overwritten with the current parameters.
presets.saveHint: The main and advanced training settings are saved. Presets are shared by all projects.
presets.changedHint: The parameters changed after the preset “{{name}}” was chosen: choose it again to restore its values.
presets.hint: A preset fills the form; values can be adjusted before the run.

section.currentEmpty: Start training in the “Settings” tab. Training progress, metrics and the log will appear here.
section.historyEmpty: No runs yet. Model versions appear after the first successful training; the first version becomes working automatically.

card.preparing: Preparing data and the training environment…

fields.noDriver: No NVIDIA driver found: the processor or a GPU number entered manually is available.
fields.groupsNote: Object detection. Settings are saved to the preset and the run snapshot.
